articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Boeing Edges Past Airbus In Deliveries While Recovery Story Stays Complicated. Boeing (NYSE:BA) has surpassed Airbus in aircraft delivery rates, marking a shift after years of production and regulatory challenges. The company reports renewed profitability alongside key wins in defense, including a PAC-3 missile seeker agreement. Boeing has supported a successful Artemis SLS core stage launch, reinforcing its role in space programs.
